description: This file declares classes and functions related to acceleration enrichment calculations in an engine control system, including acceleration correction and wall wetting (fuel film) management.

classes.name: AccelEnrichmemnt
classes.description: Class for managing acceleration enrichment based on MAP and TPS rate-of-change, including tracking previous values and enabling engine cycle updates.

classes.name: WallFuel
classes.description: Class managing wall wetting effects by tracking fuel film on walls and adjusting injector squirt durations accordingly.

methods.name: getEngineLoadEnrichment
methods.description: Returns extra engine load value for fuel logic calculation.

methods.name: getTpsEnrichment
methods.description: Returns extra fuel squirt duration for TPS acceleration.

methods.name: getMaxDeltaIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum delta index for acceleration correction.

methods.name: getMaxDelta
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum delta value for acceleration correction.

methods.name: onEngineCycle
methods.description: Handles engine cycle updates for acceleration correction.

methods.name: onEngineCycleTps
methods.description: Handles engine cycle updates specific to TPS acceleration correction.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state for acceleration correction or wall wetting classes.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the buffer length for acceleration calculations.

methods.name: onNewValue
methods.description: Processes a new sensor value for acceleration calculations.

methods.name: adjust
methods.description: Calculates adjusted fuel squirt duration considering wall wetting effects.

methods.name: getWallFuel
methods.description: Returns current wall fuel amount for a specific injector.
